name: Perplexity
tagline: AI answer engine with web search, citations, and research modes

pricing.notes: Official pages checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $20/month or $200/year.

verdictSummary: A retrieval-plus-LLM answer engine is buildable, but Perplexity's search stack, source ranking, UX, mobile/browser surfaces, and model access make full parity hard.
coreLoopDIY: Search the web/API, fetch pages, rank passages, ask an LLM to answer with citations, and store threads.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because answers arrive fast with sources and fewer query-building chores.

priorArt.name: Perplexica
priorArt.desc: Open-source AI search engine inspired by Perplexity.

notes: A nuanced kinda: there is real open-source prior art, but source quality and scale matter.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Perplexity (AI answer engine with web search, citations, and research modes). Requirements:

- Core loop: Search the web/API, fetch pages, rank passages, ask an LLM to answer with citations, and store threads.
- Needs: search API.
- Needs: web fetcher/parser.
- Needs: LLM API.
- Needs: citation renderer.
- Needs: hosted backend.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: search quality; source ranking; model routing.
